lead: Merge, split and convert PDF files right in your browser. Free, no sign-up, no watermark, and it works offline.
trust_local: Your files never leave your device
tab_split_title: Split a PDF or extract pages
tab_img2pdf_title: Turn JPG and PNG images into a PDF
tab_pdf2img_title: Save PDF pages as JPG or PNG images
drop_images: Drop JPG or PNG images here
drop_private: Opened on your device, never uploaded
drag_hint: Drag the files to change their order, or use the arrows.
range_help: Use commas and dashes, e.g. 1-3,5. “8-” means page 8 to the end. Leave empty for all pages, or tap pages below.
range_err_syntax: “{part}” is not a page or a range. Write it like 1-3,5.
range_err_out: “{part}” is outside the file: it has {pages}.
range_err_reversed: “{part}” goes backwards. Write the smaller number first.
split_mode_extract: One PDF with the selected pages
split_mode_extract_sub: 1-3,5 gives one file with pages 1, 2, 3 and 5
split_mode_ranges_sub: 1-3,5 gives two files: pages 1-3 and page 5
split_mode_each: Every page as its own PDF
done_sub: Made on your device. Nothing was uploaded.
or_each: Or download them one by one:
err_remove_bad: Remove the files marked with a problem first.
err_encrypted: {name} is password-protected. PDF Kit can’t open protected PDFs yet.
err_unreadable: {name} can’t be read as a PDF. It may be damaged.
err_badImage: {name} can’t be read as an image. Try a JPG or PNG.
pwa_text: Install PDF Kit as an app: it opens in its own window and keeps working without internet.
pwa_hint_button: You can also use “Install” in your browser’s menu.
pwa_hint_ios: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa_hint_other: In Chrome or Edge, click “Install” in the address bar or the browser menu. On Android, choose “Add to Home screen” in the menu.
pwa_ready: Ready: this page now works offline on this device.
pwa_installed: Installed: you’re using PDF Kit as an app.
how_text: PDF Kit runs entirely in your browser. Your files are opened from your device, processed in this tab and saved back to your device. Nothing is uploaded to any server, not even ours, so it is safe for private documents.
how_libs: Built on the open-source libraries pdf-lib and pdf.js, served from this site.
request_text: Tell us which everyday problem you’d like solved. We read every request.
